title: Certificates of Deposit: when a closed-account maturity instruction is replaced, and which maturity the replacement governs
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when a Certificates of Deposit certificate's maturity payout instruction names a payout account that has been closed, and the instruction is to be replaced. It fixes who owes the replacement, while the certificate is concerned, by when it is recorded, and which maturity it governs.

## Rule

1. **Owed by the bank.** The replacement is owed by the bank whether or not the owner calls.
2. **Certificates concerned.** It is owed while the certificate is active or in its grace period.
3. **Before the grace outcome.** It is recorded before the outcome of the grace period is booked, however many days have passed since the grace period ended.
4. **After the outcome.** A certificate whose grace outcome has been booked is no longer in its grace period and is not concerned.
5. **Which maturity it governs.** A change the owner makes to the maturity instruction must be recorded before the grace period ends to govern this maturity, and a change the owner records after that governs the next maturity. The one exception is this bank-owed replacement: recorded before the outcome of the grace period is booked, it governs the maturity that has just passed, because that outcome has not yet been booked.

## Status table

| Certificate status on the bank's record | Replacement owed and still recorded? |
|---|---|
| Active, before maturity | Yes |
| Grace period, grace still running | Yes |
| Grace period, grace ended but its outcome not yet booked | Yes, however many days have passed since grace ended |
| Grace outcome already booked | No, the certificate is no longer in its grace period and is not concerned |

## Owner's change and bank-owed replacement compared (illustrative dates: maturity 10 June, grace ends 15 June, outcome not yet booked on 18 June)

| Change | Recorded on | Maturity it governs |
|---|---|---|
| A change the owner records | 12 June, during grace | The maturity of 10 June |
| A change the owner records | 18 June, after grace has ended | The next maturity |
| Bank-owed replacement of a payout instruction naming a closed account | 18 June, before the grace outcome is booked | The maturity of 10 June that has just passed |

## Points of judgement

**The owner has not called about the closed account. Is the replacement still owed?**
Yes. It is owed by the bank whether or not the owner calls.

**The grace period ended several days ago, and the certificate still shows grace period status because its outcome has not been booked. Is it too late?**
No. The replacement is recorded before the outcome of the grace period is booked, however many days have passed since the grace period ended, and it governs the maturity that has just passed.

**A certificate is still in its term, well before maturity, and its payout account has already been closed. Is the replacement owed now?**
Yes. The replacement is owed while the certificate is active or in its grace period.
